function.name: calculate_time
function.description: Calculates the time taken to cover a distance at a certain speed. Note that the provided function is in Python 3 syntax.

distance.description: The distance to be covered in meters. This is a float type value.

speed.description: The speed at which the object is moving in m/s. This is a float type value.

round_to_nearest_second.description: Optional parameter to round the time to the nearest second.

message.content: 申し訳ありませんが、私はリアルタイムの時計機能を持っていません。現在の時刻はわかりません。
message.reasoning: The user asks "現在幾點了？" meaning "What time is it now?" We need to provide the current time. The system says we have no real-time clock. But we can approximate based on the current date and time from the system. The system says "Current date: 2026-06-01". But no time. We can respond with "I don't have a real-time clock, but it's currently around [some approximate time]." The user might want the exact time. We can say "I don't have a real-time clock, but it's currently around 12:00 PM." But we should not guess. We can say "I don't have a real-time clock, but it's currently around 12:00 PM." That is acceptable.
